phase: V6 Phase 10 - controlled real-world validation proposal
title: V6 Phase 10 - Controlled Real-World Validation
tagline: From Game Idea to Playable World.
decision_requested: Approve or reject the proposed stage-gated validation. No operation has run and no approval is implied.

verified: MCP tools and handlers are exactly 107/107.
The Phase 5 Unity project, scene and Windows build exist with recorded hashes.
The built Windows player ran a scripted 23-second playthrough and completed the level.
Blender 5.2.2 generated a rigged, textured character and a three-tier jungle environment.
The Unity project contains .meta import state, FBX GUID references, an animator controller referencing four clips, and a succeeded build.
not_verified: No live AI provider has returned a response body. Three approved Gemini attempts failed with HTTP 503 or read timeouts.
No live model output has been schema-validated or quality-scored.
No independent Unity import audit has measured mesh, bone, clip, texture or material correctness.
No test proves that imported clips deform the character mesh during playback.
No objective material-appearance or texture colour-space test exists.
No single run has taken a new idea through live AI, new assets, Unity integration and a new build.
No Windows soak, cold-start matrix, DPI, resolution, save-corruption or clean-machine test exists.
No human playtest or visual sign-off exists.
No release candidate combines live AI, engine import and runtime evidence.
Studio provider-to-engine import remains disabled per Phase 9 S12.

workstreams.name: Live free-tier AI provider validation
workstreams.core_question: Can one genuinely free, currently eligible provider return a valid structured game-design response for an exact approved request, with no paid fallback?

workstreams.name: Real Unity character and environment import validation
workstreams.core_question: Do the generated FBX assets import into Unity 6000.6.2f1 with correct mesh, rig, clips, textures and materials, and do they render and animate?

workstreams.name: Controlled end-to-end game generation
workstreams.core_question: Can one new idea travel through spec, approval, orchestration, new character, new environment, integration and a new playable build, with no automatic step?

workstreams.name: Windows application reliability
workstreams.core_question: Does the Windows player survive repeated starts, a soak, focus and display changes, save faults and a clean profile?

workstreams.name: Release-candidate verification
workstreams.core_question: Does the combined evidence support an honest release-candidate verdict without a production or release claim?

out_of_scope: Paid providers, paid assets and paid services.
Package installation, model download or engine installation.
Publishing, releasing, committing, pushing or tagging.
Modifying protected V4, V5, Phase 5 projects or accepted reports.

plus_release_gate.covers: Commit, push, tag, publication or release

provider_recommendation.reason: Recorded as free_limited with documented per-model limits (30 RPM, 1,000 RPD, 8,000 TPM, 200,000 TPD), no documented payment requirement and an existing OpenAI-compatible adapter.
provider_recommendation.secondary_reason: Existing adapter and prior approval path, but three live attempts failed and free-tier content may be used for product improvement.
provider_recommendation.third_reason: Only ':free' models are eligible, no specific free model is verified, and data policy varies by upstream provider.

unity_recommendation.reason: Preserves the Phase 5 project and all protected evidence while still using the exact engine version and asset set.

required_approvals.scope: Commit, push, tag, publish or release

acceptance_criteria: Approval: every operation maps to an approved stage, exact input hash and request count.
Live AI: one successful schema-valid response, or an explicit honest failure with no success claim.
Unity import: zero import errors and measured mesh, bone, clip and material facts.
Animation: four clips bind and sampled bone motion exceeds 1 cm (5 cm for Jump).
Materials: all slots resolve, no error shader, textures bound, human visual review recorded.
End-to-end: one new idea reaches a new build through all approved stages.
Windows reliability: 20/20 cold starts, 60-minute soak, focus/resolution/DPI/save tests pass.
Preservation: no protected V4, V5, Phase 5 or accepted-report modification.
Cost: zero paid requests and zero paid fallback.
Honesty: every criterion is PASS, FAIL, NOT_TESTED or HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED with evidence.
Sign-off: a named human accepts or rejects the release candidate.

top_risks.risk: Provider requires billing or paid upgrade
top_risks.mitigation: hard free-only gate and stop on any billing prompt
presence-only checks, redaction, secret scan, rotation on exposure
disposable lab, source read-only, 38-hash check before and after

top_risks.risk: Historical evidence mistaken for current proof
top_risks.mitigation: fresh timestamped artifact per stage and explicit verification vocabulary

top_risks.risk: Scope expands into an automatic full pipeline
top_risks.mitigation: 16 separate approval gates and no automatic chaining

stop_conditions_summary: Protected hash or protected path change
Billing, card or paid tier requested
Model absent from the current free list
Unity import error or missing script/shader/material
Request to modify V5 or the Phase 5 project
Stage exceeds approved time or request count
Missing, expired or mismatched human approval
approval_scope_note: The Phase 9 S12, S14 and R3 decisions accept documented limitations only. They do not authorize Phase 10, live requests, engine imports, builds or releases. This proposal does not inherit or imply any such authorization.
what_approval_of_this_proposal_would_mea: It would authorize only the first gate, P10-S0 baseline re-verification, if the user explicitly says so. It would not authorize a live request, credential use, engine import, build or release.
what_approval_of_this_proposal_would_not: It would not start Phase 10 execution.
It would not authorize any network request.
It would not authorize credential access.
It would not authorize a Unity or Blender build.
It would not authorize asset import.
It would not authorize a commit, push, tag, publication or release.
It would not make the product production-ready.
